PHYT 701.description: Intensive study and analysis of the morphologic, functional and imaging anatomy of the human body. Emphasis on the relationship of form and function as a basis for understanding of human movement.
PHYT 701.subject: PHYT
PHYT 701.title: Human Musculoskeletal and Gross Anatomy

PHYT 702.description: In depth, hands on study and analysis of the major gross anatomical structures, their relationships to each other and the clinical importance through cadaveric dissection.
PHYT 702.subject: PHYT
PHYT 702.title: Musculoskeletal and Gross Anatomy Dissection

PHYT 720.description: An overview of the basic skills needed by the physical therapist related to patient evaluation and management.
PHYT 720.subject: PHYT
PHYT 720.title: Fundamentals of Physical Therapy

PHYT 721.description: Presents the role of the physical therapist in health promotion and wellness for patients/clients and the community.
PHYT 721.subject: PHYT
PHYT 721.title: Health Promotion Wellness in Physical Therapy

PHYT 731.description: A study of theories and mechanisms involved in human movement. Focus is on analysis of principles and systems of gross motor control and learning.
PHYT 731.subject: PHYT
PHYT 731.title: Mechanisms of Motor Skill Performance

PHYT 740.description: PHYT 740 is designed to allow you to enhance patient interaction through the development of professional communication skills, to explore professional ethics and the APTA Core Values, and to foster a professional identity.
PHYT 740.subject: PHYT
PHYT 740.title: Professional Issues in Physical Therapy

PHYT 741.description: Enhance patient interaction through the development of professional communication skills, to develop appropriate documentation skills, and to foster a professional identity.
PHYT 741.subject: PHYT
PHYT 741.title: Clinical Documentation in Physical Therapy

PHYT 742.description: Examination of the physical therapist's role within healthcare systems and professional organizations, with focus on professional communication, interprofessional practice, public policy, and advocacy.
PHYT 742.subject: PHYT
PHYT 742.title: Professional Issues in Physical Therapy II

PHYT 743.description: Preparation for entry into the physical therapy profession through exploration of licensure exam preparation, post-professional opportunities, and development of essential career skills.
PHYT 743.subject: PHYT
PHYT 743.title: Professional Issues in Physical Therapy III

PHYT 749.description: Theoretical and practical approaches to physical therapy treatment of orthopedic diagnoses including therapeutic exercise, therapeutic activities, mobility, joint and soft tissue mobilization and manipulation, and functional task practice.
PHYT 749.subject: PHYT
PHYT 749.title: Orthopedic Physical Therapy Interventions

PHYT 750.description: Fundamental principles of physical therapy examination and evaluation for people with orthopedic disorders with an emphasis on lumbar spine and lower extremities.
PHYT 750.subject: PHYT
PHYT 750.title: Orthopedic Physical Therapy I

PHYT 751.description: Fundamental principles of physical therapy examination and evaluation for people with orthopedic disorders with an emphasis on thoracic and cervical spine and upper extremities.
PHYT 751.subject: PHYT
PHYT 751.title: Orthopedic Physical Therapy II

PHYT 752.description: An advanced course to enhance physical therapy students’ knowledge of orthopedic examination tests and manual therapy interventions. Emphasis will be placed on diagnostic accuracy of special tests (sensitivity, specificity, likelihood ratios, reliability and validity), interpretation of the results, proper execution, and integration of manual techniques into clinical practice.
PHYT 752.subject: PHYT
PHYT 752.title: Orthopedic Integration in Physical Therapy

PHYT 753.description: Fundamentals of developing a research proposal.
PHYT 753.subject: PHYT
PHYT 753.title: Research Proposal Development

PHYT 754.description: Joint and soft tissue mobilization and manipulation techniques.
PHYT 754.subject: PHYT
PHYT 754.title: Manual Therapy I

PHYT 755.description: Techniques will include spinal mobilization, mobilization with movement, manipulation, muscle energy, taping, soft tissue mobilization and integration of techniques into clinical practice.
PHYT 755.subject: PHYT
PHYT 755.title: Manual Therapy II

PHYT 756.description: Physical therapy management of patients with integumentary disorders.
PHYT 756.subject: PHYT
PHYT 756.title: Integumentary Physical Therapy

PHYT 757.description: Management of the physical therapy patient on selected medications.
PHYT 757.subject: PHYT
PHYT 757.title: Pharmacology for the Physical Therapist

PHYT 758.description: Role of the physical therapist in professional and patient education.
PHYT 758.subject: PHYT
PHYT 758.title: Patient Education in Physical Therapy

PHYT 759.description: Therapeutic exercise for the orthopedic patient: selection of techniques, rate of progression and modification.
PHYT 759.subject: PHYT
PHYT 759.title: Therapeutic Exercise

PHYT 760.description: Management of patients with amputations, prosthetics, and orthotics.
PHYT 760.subject: PHYT
PHYT 760.title: Orthotics and Prosthetics

PHYT 761.description: This course will address the theoretical models for understanding the basis for pain. Pain assessment and physical therapy pain management will be addressed. Emphasis will be placed on the development of clinical decision-making and problem solving.
PHYT 761.subject: PHYT
PHYT 761.title: Pain Mechanisms and Treatment

PHYT 763.description: This course studies theoretical and practical applications for safe, effective use of biophysical agents commonly used in physical therapy settings using evidence based practice.
PHYT 763.subject: PHYT
PHYT 763.title: Biophysical Agents in Physical Therapy

PHYT 764.description: Cultural competencies necessary for the delivery of health care to patients of diverse ethno-cultural heritages.
PHYT 764.subject: PHYT
PHYT 764.title: Cultural Competence in Health Care

PHYT 765.description: Fundamental principles for assessment, treatment and overall foundations of geriatric physical therapy based upon the best available evidence.
PHYT 765.subject: PHYT
PHYT 765.title: Geriatric Physical Therapy

PHYT 766.description: Physical therapy management of patients/clients with acute and chronic cardiac and/or pulmonary dysfunction.
PHYT 766.subject: PHYT
PHYT 766.title: Essentials of Cardiopulmonary Physical Therapy

PHYT 770.description: Cognitive and motor skills required in the management of the acute care physical therapy patient.
PHYT 770.subject: PHYT
PHYT 770.title: Acute Care Physical Therapy

PHYT 775.description: Fundamental theory and practical implications of examination for the clinical physical therapy patient.
PHYT 775.subject: PHYT
PHYT 775.title: Introduction to Examination, Evaluation, and Intervention I

PHYT 776.description: Fundamental theory and practical implications of examination, evaluation and intervention for the clinical physical therapy patient with special emphasis on therapeutic exercise for lumbar and lower extremity.
PHYT 776.subject: PHYT
PHYT 776.title: Introduction to Examination, Evaluation, and Intervention II

PHYT 777.description: A study of selected issues in the field of physical therapy. Course content varies by title. May be repeated for credit as topics vary for a maximum of 6 credit hours total.
PHYT 777.subject: PHYT
PHYT 777.title: Special Topics in Physical Therapy

PHYT 782.description: Biomechanical principles underlying motor control and selected techniques used to quantify human movement.
PHYT 782.subject: PHYT
PHYT 782.title: Functional Anatomy

PHYT 784.description: Application of evidence-based practice to the clinical physical therapy setting with a focus on asking focused clinical questions, searching for the best available evidence, research design and ethics.
PHYT 784.subject: PHYT
PHYT 784.title: Evidence-Based Practice in Physical Therapy I

PHYT 785.description: Critical review of professional literature pertaining to clinical practice in physical therapy. Repeatable for credit.
PHYT 785.subject: PHYT
PHYT 785.title: Seminar in Physical Therapy

PHYT 786.description: Presentation and discussion of current research topics in physical therapy.
PHYT 786.subject: PHYT
PHYT 786.title: Research Seminar in Physical Therapy

PHYT 787.description: Exploration of contemporary physical therapy practice, the application of research evidence to physical therapy practice, and interprofessional and professional service activities.
PHYT 787.subject: PHYT
PHYT 787.title: Seminar and Research in Physical Therapy

PHYT 788.description: Application of evidence-based practice to the clinical physical therapy setting with a focus on statistical methods and interpretation, critical appraisal of the evidence, and clinical decision making.
PHYT 788.subject: PHYT
PHYT 788.title: Evidence-Based Practice in Physical Therapy II

PHYT 790.description: Topics to be approved by advisor and graduate director. Pass/fail grading.
PHYT 790.subject: PHYT
PHYT 790.title: Independent Study

PHYT 806.description: Students will gain knowledge and expertise to competently screen for systemic diseases, interpret clinical findings and differentially diagnose movement related impairments from medical conditions that can mimic symptoms of neuromusculoskeletal problems. Emphasis will be placed on Skills necessary to identify patient/client problems that require referral to another health professional.
PHYT 806.subject: PHYT
PHYT 806.title: Differential Diagnosis and Clinical Reasoning for Physical Therapists

PHYT 807.description: A study of neuroplasticity and genetics in relation to motor rehabilitation. Focus is on the analysis and application of key constructs in the design and implementation of rehabilitation interventions in individuals with neurologic diagnoses.
PHYT 807.subject: PHYT
PHYT 807.title: Neuroplasticity and Genetics in Physical Therapy

PHYT 808.description: Examination of neural repair and rehabilitation from a clinical perspective.
PHYT 808.subject: PHYT
PHYT 808.title: Neuro Repair - Rehabilitation

PHYT 809.description: Neurological conditions and interventions commonly used in physical therapy practice.

PHYT 809.title: Neuromuscular Assessment and Treatment I

PHYT 810.description: Neurological conditions and interventions commonly used in physical therapy practice.
PHYT 810.subject: PHYT
PHYT 810.title: Neuromuscular Assessment and Treatment II

PHYT 811.description: Assessment and evaluation of selected pediatric conditions.
PHYT 811.subject: PHYT
PHYT 811.title: Pediatric Physical Therapy

PHYT 812.description: Application of evidence-based clinical reasoning to complex case scenarios for a variety of body systems and physical therapy patient populations.
PHYT 812.subject: PHYT
PHYT 812.title: Integrated Patient Management

PHYT 815.description: Theory and application of management supervision and leadership skills necessary for the practice of physical therapy.
PHYT 815.subject: PHYT
PHYT 815.title: Management of Physical Therapy Practice

PHYT 850.description: A 320 hour clinical education experience to develop physical therapy management skills of orthopedic patients.
PHYT 850.subject: PHYT
PHYT 850.title: Clinical Experience in Physical Therapy I

PHYT 851.description: A 320-hour clinical education experience to develop physical therapy management skills of acute care patients.
PHYT 851.subject: PHYT
PHYT 851.title: Clinical Experience in Physical Therapy II

PHYT 852.title: Clinical Experience in Physical Therapy III

PHYT 853.description: Supervised clinical experience in a physical therapy setting.
PHYT 853.subject: PHYT
PHYT 853.title: Clinical Experience in Physical Therapy IV

PHYT 860.description: An 80 hour clinical education experience to demonstrate professional behaviors while safely managing a partial caseload.
PHYT 860.subject: PHYT
PHYT 860.title: Clinical Experience in Physical Therapy IVa
